authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

description.en: Self-declaration-based online registration for micro, small and medium enterprises through the Udyam Registration Portal, providing official MSME classification and access to government benefits and schemes.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Enterprises with investment up to Rs. 1 crore and turnover up to Rs. 5 crore
verifiedConditions.claim: Micro enterprises are defined as those with investment in plant and machinery or equipment not exceeding Rs. 1 crore and annual turnover not exceeding Rs. 5 crore.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Enterprises with investment up to Rs. 10 crore and turnover up to Rs. 50 crore
verifiedConditions.claim: Small enterprises are defined as those with investment in plant and machinery or equipment not exceeding Rs. 10 crore and annual turnover not exceeding Rs. 50 crore.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Enterprises with investment up to Rs. 50 crore and turnover up to Rs. 250 crore
verifiedConditions.claim: Medium enterprises are defined as those with investment in plant and machinery or equipment not exceeding Rs. 50 crore and annual turnover not exceeding Rs. 250 crore.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Proprietors, partners, or authorized signatories registering on Udyam portal
verifiedConditions.claim: Aadhaar number of the proprietor (for proprietorship), managing partner (for partnership), or authorized signatory (for companies/LLPs) is mandatory for Udyam registration.

unverifiedEligibility: Both manufacturing and service enterprises are eligible for Udyam registration.
Enterprises already holding EM-Part-II or UAM registration are expected to re-register on the Udyam portal.
This record does not cover Udyam Assist Platform registration for informal/micro enterprises without PAN or GSTIN.

requirements.claim: Aadhaar number of the proprietor, managing partner, or karta is mandatory. For companies and LLPs, the Aadhaar of the authorized signatory along with GSTIN and PAN of the organization is required.
PAN is required for enterprises with turnover above the GST threshold. PAN and GSTIN details are auto-verified from government databases.
Bank account details including account number and IFSC code are required as part of the self-declaration.
The registration is based entirely on self-declaration. No documents, certificates, or proof need to be uploaded. Investment and turnover figures are self-declared.
Enterprise details including name, type of organization, address, date of commencement, NIC code of activity, number of employees, investment in plant and machinery, and turnover are required.

processInformation.claim: Visit the official Udyam Registration Portal at udyamregistration.gov.in and click on 'For New Entrepreneurs who are not Registered yet as MSME or those with EM-II'.
Enter Aadhaar number and name as per Aadhaar. OTP verification is performed on the Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
If applicable, PAN and GSTIN are entered and auto-validated against government databases. Investment and turnover data may be auto-populated from ITR and GSTN.
Fill in enterprise details including type of organization, address, date of commencement, bank details, main business activity (NIC code), number of employees, investment and turnover figures.
Submit the self-declaration form. No document upload is required. The enterprise is classified as micro, small, or medium based on the declared investment and turnover.
Udyam Registration Certificate with a permanent Udyam Registration Number is generated. The e-certificate can be downloaded and printed from the portal.

output.claim: An e-certificate of Udyam Registration is issued containing the permanent Udyam Registration Number (starting with UDYAM-XX-00-0000000), enterprise name, classification (micro/small/medium), NIC code, and date of registration. The certificate is dynamic and updates automatically based on ITR and GST return data.

fees.applicability: Udyam Registration through the official portal
fees.claim: Udyam Registration is completely free of cost. No fee is charged for registration on the official Udyam Registration Portal.
No authorized service-centre charge is established. The portal warns against paying any fee for registration to third parties.

processingTime.applicability: New Udyam Registration through the official portal
processingTime.claim: Udyam Registration is typically instant upon successful submission and Aadhaar verification. In some cases where PAN/GSTIN validation takes additional time, the certificate may be issued within 2-3 working days.

sources.title: Udyam Registration Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The Udyam Registration Portal provides the official self-declaration-based registration facility for MSMEs, including classification criteria, Aadhaar-based registration process, and free-of-cost certificate issuance.
claimsSupported: Udyam Registration is the official MSME registration process replacing UAM.
Registration is based on self-declaration with no document upload required.
Classification is based on investment and turnover criteria.
A permanent Udyam Registration Number and e-certificate are issued.
Registration is typically instant upon Aadhaar verification.
sources.uncertainty: Processing time for PAN/GSTIN validation and auto-population of data from government databases may vary.

sources.title: Ministry of MSME — Official Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The Ministry of MSME portal provides policy information, scheme details, and links to the Udyam Registration Portal. It describes the MSME classification criteria and benefits including priority sector lending, subsidies, and MSME SAMADHAAN delayed payment portal.
claimsSupported: Ministry of MSME is the administrative authority for Udyam Registration.
MSME classification follows investment and turnover criteria as per the revised notification.
Registered MSMEs can access benefits including priority sector lending, government subsidies, MSME SAMADHAAN for delayed payments, and various government schemes.
The Udyam Registration Certificate is a dynamic document that updates based on ITR and GST data.
sources.uncertainty: Specific scheme eligibility and benefits may vary and are subject to individual scheme guidelines.

limitations: This record covers new Udyam Registration only. It does not cover Udyam Assist Platform for informal/unregistered micro enterprises.
Specific government scheme benefits and eligibility criteria for registered MSMEs are not detailed in this record.
The record does not cover migration from old EM-II or UAM registration to Udyam.
Export promotion and international trade benefits for MSMEs are not covered.
Classification reclassification process when investment or turnover changes is not detailed.
Benefits such as priority lending, subsidies, and MSME SAMADHAAN are mentioned but not individually modeled.

review.reviewReason: Core registration process and classification criteria are reviewed, but scheme-specific benefits, Udyam Assist Platform, and migration processes need additional coverage.
nextReviewTrigger: Changes to MSME classification criteria (investment/turnover thresholds).

New government notifications affecting MSME registration requirements.
